items.utterance: It is well known that a triangle has 4 sides.

The river keeps the sky's secrets folded in its bends.
Dawn unbuttons the gray coat of the sleeping city.
The old oak holds the storm in its patient hands.
Night sews silver thread through the torn hem of the evening.
The wind hums low through the hollow bones of winter trees.
Rain tattoos the pavement with a thousand small goodbyes.
The stars blink out one by one like tired shopkeepers.
